newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-NILIS HITS HAT-TRICK AS PSV WIN AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NILIS HITS HAT-TRICK AS PSV WIN AGAIN.

text.p: Belgian international Luc Nilis scored a hat-trick as PSV Eindhoven maintained their 100 percent record by beating RKC Waalwijk 4-0 on Thursday.
The result took PSV two points clear of Feyenoord Rotterdam at the top of the Dutch first division, and five points clear of Ajax Amsterdam, who drew 0-0 at Roda JC Kerkrade on Wednesday.
It took the home side over half an hour to break down a hardworking RKC defence, but once they did, there was no stopping them.
Nilis opening the scoring from close range in the 38th minute, then curled a freekick round the wall and into the net three minutes later to give PSV a 2-0 halftime lead.
Rene Eykelkamp scored his side's third goal on the hour before Nilis completed his hat-trick with another close-range effort, his sixth goal in four matches.
Eindhoven have won their first four league games, scoring 15 goals and conceding only three.
Champions Ajax are seventh with two wins from four.
